From Horus · Price: it needs moisture in the air (not in deserts or dry places).

Theme Force and Energy

  • 1: 1 action: ice shard, range 30 ft, @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level-1)/4))d6[cold]] (@Check[reflex|against:stand|basic]{basic Reflex}).
  • 5: Surge, 2 actions: wall of ice, 20 ft long, Hardness 5, 20 HP per 5 ft, lasts 1 minute.
  • 9: Surge: ice spears in a @Template[burst|distance:10]{10-ft burst}: @Damage[(2*ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[cold]] (@Check[reflex|against:stand|basic]{basic Reflex}).
  • 13: Shards slow on critical failure (–10 ft Speed for 1 round).
  • 17: Freeze a creature in ice (@Check[fortitude|against:stand|traits:incapacitation]{Fortitude}, incapacitation): @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{restrained} for 1 round, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{paralyzed} on a critical failure.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC.
